text:
Lumen Field mepere na 28 July 2002, e wulitere ya n'ebe Kingdome mebiri emebi na ihe dị ka $430 nde, ihe dị ka $770 nde na 2025 dollar. Ọ malitere dị ka Seahawks Stadium, ụlọ ọhụrụ nke NFL's Seattle Seahawks, ndị na-egwuri egwu ebe ahụ kemgbe 2002.

Aha ebe ahụ agbanweela ọtụtụ oge n'oge ndụ ya. Ọ ghọrọ Qwest Field na 2004, CenturyLink Field na 2011, na Lumen Field na November 2020 mgbe Lumen Technologies gasịrị. Maka FIFA World Cup, iwu aha ụlọ ọrụ FIFA na-ewepụ aha onye nkwado, ma a kpọrọ ala ahụ Seattle Stadium maka asọmpi ahụ.

Washington State Public Stadium Authority nwere stadium ahụ ma Ellerbe Becket chepụtara ya na mmekorita ya na LMN Architects, tinyere Streeter & Associates. Ọ dị na 800 Occidental Avenue South na mpaghara SoDo nke Seattle, dị nso na etiti obodo.

Ọ bụ ezie na e chepụtara ya dị ka ebe bọọlụ na soccer, Lumen Field toro ka ọ bụrụ otu n'ime ala kachasị ọrụ na egwuregwu America. Na mgbakwunye na Seahawks, ọ ghọrọ ụlọ nke MLS's Seattle Sounders FC site na 2009 na nke NWSL's Seattle Reign FC site na 2022, na-enye otu stadium ndị nwe ọkachamara atọ. Nhazi ya na-agbanwe iji dabara: ihe dị ka 68,740 maka NFL na nke nwere ike ịgbasa ruo ihe dị ka 72,000 maka mmemme pụrụ iche, ihe dị ka 37,722 maka MLS, na ihe dị ka 10,000 maka NWSL.

Ebe egwuregwu ahụ nwere akụkọ nke ya. Na mpụga World Cup, ala ahụ na-eji elu FieldTurf CORE artificial, nke etinyere na March 2024. Maka asọmpi 2026, a gbanwere ya ka ọ bụrụ ebe ahịhịa na-adịru nwa oge na ahịhịa ngwakọ, nke toro na Moses Lake, WA, ma tinye ya n'elu turf dị adị.

Site na aha na-agbanwe na ndị nkwado ya ruo n'ọhịa na-agbanwe na kalenda ya, Lumen Field ka bụ ihe dị mkpa nke njirimara egwuregwu Seattle ruo ihe karịrị afọ iri abụọ, ebe multi-purpose e wulitere iji nabata nnukwu ihe omume obodo.
